COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_directors_take_over.problem: The entry focus switched the programme on with four lines including +10 % corporate tax (about 5.5 points for a cost-3 focus); trimmed to three starting lines.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_shadow_capitalism.problem: Legalising the shadow economy gave only the idea swap and oligarch opinion (about 3 points for cost 5); it now also fills shelves through the programme and pays with Party anger.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_mvd_state.problem: The MVD focus gave only +2 % stability and one police-cost line for cost 5; it now builds Shchelokov's power base (drift defence, PP) and costs KGB goodwill.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_model.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small political reward for settling the directors' model.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_nomenklatura_privatisatio.problem: Privatisation gave one productivity line and a faction bonus against -3 % stability (under 2 points for cost 5); ministries turned holding companies now also yield corporate income and win the combine managers.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_clan_economy.problem: Clan rule gave cohesion against corruption only (1.5 points for cost 5); the republican bosses now also keep the Union quiet and pay tribute in PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_cotton_and_caviar.problem: A single resource-export line at +10 % for cost 5 and no price for an openly corrupt trade; now hard-currency proceeds with a visible corruption cost.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_directors_banks.problem: The office was paid at 0.6 % GDP, half the standard 1.3 %; price corrected and the new bankers' backing added.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_western_accounts.problem: The focus had only costs (GDP, stability) for +10 oligarch opinion, about -1 point at cost 5; it now buys elite loyalty (PP) and Western goods, and the price is Imperia's sanction exposure and scandal risk instead of a flat stability hit.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_question.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling who owns the Union.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_directors_republic.problem: One corporate-tax line for a cost-5 regime change; the holding-company state now also cuts bureaucracy and wins the combines, while the unions lose their voice.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_buy_the_people.problem: Stability +5 % against a social-cost line was about 1.5 points for cost 5; the bought social peace now also shows in the programme, the unions and the party's popularity.

COLDWAR_SOV_rd_the_corporate_union.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds a programme payoff, PP and the oligarchs' backing.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_free_the_prices.problem: Price liberalisation gave less than nothing (stability -5 % against one tax line and the idea removal); the freed prices now also lift productivity and cut consumer-goods drain.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_the_rouble_convertible.problem: Trade opinion against higher interest was about 1 point for cost 5 and ignored Imperia globalism; now opens the economy (globalism +10) at the price of Cold War market exposure and the foreign-trade old guard.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_the_speed.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the reform pace.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_shock_therapy.problem: Shock therapy cost -8 % stability for one +5 % productivity line (about -2.3 points); the shock now pays off in efficiency, taxes and the inflation windfall, still at a visible social price.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_step_by_step.problem: A single +3 % stability line for cost 5; the gradual Hungarian-style reform now also frees services, light industry and agriculture.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_voucher_privatisation.problem: Corporate tax +10 % on the permanent Gosplan modifier against -20 nomenklatura was oversized in value but about 1 point; now a moderate tax line plus the people-as-owners payoff in stability and party popularity.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_open_to_investment.problem: Cheaper incoming investment and a loan gave 3 points for cost 5; adds the Imperia investment slot and Western know-how, priced with lower foreign-influence defence.

COLDWAR_SOV_fel_the_market_union.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff and a tax payoff.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_the_green_cabinet.problem: Entry programme was 2 points for cost 3 (a productivity cost line offsets half of it); adds a starting PP grant.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_save_baikal.problem: Closing the mill gave +2 % stability and a little popularity against a factory-output loss (under 1 point for cost 5); the scientists' victory now pays in stability, research and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_stop_the_rivers.problem: Cancelling the river reversal gave +2 % stability against -2 cohesion (0 points for cost 5); the saved mega-project budget is now returned, with Central Asian dismay as the price.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_the_path.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the movement's direction.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_green_socialism.problem: Two small programme lines for cost 5; ecological planning now also builds a paid renewable plant and lowers health costs.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_conservation_first.problem: Mining law plus one stability line for cost 5; adds the Imperia oil-dependency hook (less fuel use) and lower health costs.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_save_the_aral.problem: Cohesion +4 against an agriculture-tax loss was 1 point for cost 5; the grateful republics now also stabilise the Union.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_close_semipalatinsk.problem: Cohesion and -1 tension against the generals' anger was 1 point for cost 5; the goodwill gesture now also helps our image abroad (support effectiveness, trade opinion).

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_the_rbmk_question.problem: Only an energy loss plus removing the RBMK accident flag; heeding the physicists now also gives reactor and general research and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_fob_the_green_union.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff that offsets the entry's productivity cost and two paid renewable plants.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_an_early_glasnost.problem: Research +3 % against drift defence -5 % and stability -2 % was below zero for cost 5; glasnost now brings the Thaw atmosphere, popularity and PP, with the weaker drift defence as the only price.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_cooperative_law.problem: Only the idea swap (2 points) for cost 5; the cooperatives now also ease consumer supply and lift productivity.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_model.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the reform model.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_self_management.problem: One stability line and union opinion for cost 5; workers' councils now also raise productivity and the party's standing.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_new_mechanism.problem: One productivity line for cost 5; the Hungarian mechanism now also raises factory efficiency and tax yield.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_open_to_the_world.problem: Trade opinion and -1 tension for cost 5; opening now raises Imperia globalism at the price of market exposure, and scientists' travel lifts research.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_federal_reform.problem: Cohesion alone (3 points) for cost 5; the republics' new powers now also stabilise the Union, while the Moscow ministries lose out.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_question.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling how far the market goes.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_socialist_market.problem: Only +3 % stability for cost 5; keeping public ownership now also reassures the Party and settles the programme.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_mixed_economy.problem: Trade law plus -2 % stability was below zero for cost 5; private enterprise now also pays in productivity and corporate income.

COLDWAR_SOV_smc_the_commonwealth.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff and cohesion for the voluntary commonwealth.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_a_union_of_sovereign_rep.problem: Cohesion +10 on top of the programme made the cost-3 entry worth 5.5 points; cohesion trimmed to +5.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_the_new_union_treaty.problem: Cohesion +10 came on top of the treaty offer, whose signings add +2 each; direct cohesion halved and replaced by Union stability and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_our_soviet_ukraine.problem: Our opinion of Ukraine plus +3 cohesion (1.5 points) for cost 5; the Ukrainian programme now also stabilises the Union and pleases the grain farmers.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_the_model.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the shape of the Union.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_many_paths.problem: Cohesion +8 was the only reward and above the per-focus range; korenizatsiya now also cools nationalism through the Union modifier.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_the_kiev_axis.problem: Cohesion and +3 % PP gain (2.6 points) for cost 5; the Moscow-Kiev core now gives a firmer centre (PP, stability) while the smaller republics grumble (lower cohesion gain).

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_economic_sovereignty.problem: One productivity line and cohesion for cost 5; the sovnarkhoz-style reform now also raises factory efficiency and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_republic_formations.problem: +20,000 manpower is negligible for the USSR and MD never grants positive manpower; national formations now raise conscription and morale and train the army.

COLDWAR_SOV_usr_the_commonwealth_of_sovi.problem: Cohesion +10 exceeds the per-focus maximum of 5; trimmed and replaced by PP and a programme payoff.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_russian_party.problem: The programme start was cancelled out by -5 cohesion (0.5 points for cost 3); the cohesion cost is softened and a starting PP grant added.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_molodaya_gvardiya_lin.problem: Party popularity and one drift-defence line (2.25 points) for cost 5; the patriotic press campaign now carries the Russian Revival spirit and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_russian_village_first.problem: The heartland revival promised roads, housing and machinery but gave no buildings; adds paid agriculture districts and roads plus stability.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_model.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling Red or White.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_national_bolshevism.problem: Programme lines and CPSU popularity (2.25 points) for cost 5; red greatness now also wins the cadres and the army and adds war support.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_orthodox_nationalism.problem: Clergy faction and one stability line for cost 5; the Church as a pillar now also strengthens drift defence, while atheist cadres object.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_a_communist_party_for_the.problem: -5 cohesion against one PP line was below zero for cost 5; the new Central Committee now gives posts to the cadres, popularity and PP, and the republics' fear costs less cohesion.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_slavic_core.problem: Only the offer (no own reward) on a cost-5 focus; our side now gains PP and a firmer Union core whatever Kiev and Minsk answer.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_great_power_army.problem: Morale +5 % and military opinion (2.7 points) for cost 5; the army's new prestige now also brings XP, organisation and war support, paid from the budget.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_question.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling Empire or Nation.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_empire.problem: Cohesion and war support against a police-cost line (3.2 points) for cost 5; holding the empire now also hardens drift defence.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_the_nation.problem: -10 cohesion against +5 % stability was -2.5 points for cost 5; cutting the borderland subsidies now returns money and wins Russian voters, at a softened cohesion cost.

COLDWAR_SOV_rp_great_russia.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff, popularity and stability.

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_the_emergency_committee.problem: PP 75 against -25 nomenklatura was below zero for cost 5; rule by decree now strengthens the programme, strips privileges (less corruption) and rallies the dispossessed.

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_militarise_the_nation.problem: +50,000 manpower is negligible and MD never grants positive manpower; the armed nation now raises conscription, mobilisation speed, war support and XP.

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_the_path.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling isolation or expansion.

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_fortress_russia.problem: Closed economy and one core-defence line (2.2 points) for cost 5; the sealed fortress now resists sanctions and foreign propaganda (Imperia sanction resistance, Cold War ideological defence).

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_the_revanche.problem: A stand-alone +3 % attack line plus +5 tension for cost 5 breaks the combat-buff rule; now a paid offensive posture with planning, the Cold War 'Show of Strength' spirit and war support.

COLDWAR_SOV_cnr_the_rebirth_state.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff and popularity.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_marshals_govern.problem: Entry programme was 2.2 points for cost 3 after its two cost lines; the army's takeover now also shows in military opinion.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_general_staff_govern.problem: Military opinion and command power (2.5 points) for cost 5; staff methods now speed up administration and industry, while civilian research is sidelined.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_order_and_discipline.problem: Stability and one corruption step (3 points) for cost 5; the crackdown now also ends the Second Economy spirit and lifts labour discipline (productivity).

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_model.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the army's doctrine debate.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_modernisers.problem: Slightly under the cost-5 budget; the defence industry's backing for Ogarkov's programme is added.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_old_marshals.problem: +3 % defence is below the 5 % combat-line minimum and +50,000 manpower is negligible; mass armies now get a paid defence line, faster mobilisation and XP.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_military_economy.problem: Two arms factories were paid 1.2 % GDP instead of the standard 1.6 % and the focus gave little besides; price corrected, the defence industry now runs the plan (arms output, military tax income).

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_defence_council.problem: PP 75 and one planning line (2.5 points) for cost 5; single-room decisions now also cut bureaucracy and raise PP gain in the programme.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_strategic_deterrence.problem: An unpaid ICBM bonus plus tension (1.5 points) for cost 5; strategic foci are always paid in MD, so the build-up now costs GDP and gives rocket forces, deterrence and war support.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_question.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling how long the marshals rule.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_return_to_the_barracks.problem: Stability against military opinion (1.5 points) for cost 5; the Party's return now also wins the cadres and the army keeps a permanent prestige line.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_permanent_stavka.problem: Two programme lines (2.5 points) for cost 5; the war-footing state now also gets faster mobilisation, more planning and war support.

COLDWAR_SOV_com_the_garrison_state.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff and army XP.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_return_of_the_tsar.problem: Entry programme was 2.6 points for cost 3; adds the monarchists' popularity boost.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_coronation.problem: Stability and PP (3.5 points) for cost 5; the coronation now also lifts the crown's popularity and PP gain.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_church_and_the_crown.problem: Clergy faction and +3 % stability (2.5 points) for cost 5; the Church's blessing now also strengthens the programme.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_form.problem: Choice hub with only a design note (no reward); gives a small reward for settling the form of the monarchy.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_constitutional_monarchy.problem: Elections and two small programme lines (1.5 points) for cost 5; the parliamentary crown now gains popularity, PP and Western trade goodwill.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_autocrat.problem: Two programme lines (3 points) for cost 5; autocracy now also gives PP and the secret police's loyalty.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_emigres_return.problem: Research and trade lines (3 points) for cost 5; the returning émigrés now also bring capital (cheaper incoming investment) and PP.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_crown_and_the_republ.problem: -5 cohesion against +2 % stability was below zero for cost 5; self-government under the dynasty now steadies the republics that stay, at a smaller cohesion cost.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_royal_houses.problem: Only the offer (no own reward) on a cost-5 focus; seeking recognition now also gives PP, legitimacy (drift defence) and trade goodwill whatever London and Madrid answer.

COLDWAR_SOV_rom_the_restored_empire.problem: Cost-7 capstone gave only its idea (2 points); adds PP, a programme payoff, popularity and the Church's backing.
